Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a tagged NSMF protein. While the PRIDE metadata mentions 'No PTMs are included in the dataset', the methods section explicitly states that phosphorylation, acetylation, and oxidation were searched as variable modifications in Sequest, suggesting a PTM-aware search was performed.

scope: To identify NSMF-associated proteins, HEK293T cells were transfected with S-FLAG-streptavidin binding peptide (SFB)-tagged NSMF plasmid. SFB-NSMF and associated proteins were immunoprecipitated from cell lysates using FLAG-M2 affinity gel (Sigma-Aldrich), and the immunoprecipitated proteins were separated by SDS-PAGE.
